hypotheses.W1_factored_native_operator_matches_head: The independently applied target operator matches its native routed head write within 1e-4 relative error.
hypotheses.W2_controls_match_operator_angle_and_nor: Every control matches the partner's absolute operator cosine and native operator norm within 1e-5.
hypotheses.W3_partner_operator_is_privileged: The partner transplant has lower KL than the median matched control in both directions and evaluation halves.
hypotheses.W4_partner_operator_beats_control_tail: The partner transplant is below the control p10 in at least one direction on both halves.
hypotheses.W5_partner_operator_beats_deletion: The partner transplant has lower KL than deleting the target value-side head operator in both directions and halves.
hypotheses.W6_operator_advantage_is_split_stable: Partner/control ratios differ by at most 0.25 across halves for both directions.
